options.name: Combat Trick
options.benefit: Gain a combat feat; may be selected more than once.

options.name: Fast Stealth
options.benefit: Move at full speed while using Stealth without the normal penalty.

options.name: Finesse Rogue
options.benefit: Gain Weapon Finesse as a bonus feat.

options.name: Firearm Training
options.benefit: Gain Exotic Weapon Proficiency with one firearm.

options.name: Ranger Combat Style
options.benefit: Gain a ranger combat-style feat without meeting its normal prerequisites.

options.name: Slowing Strike
options.benefit: A studied target damaged by sneak attack has its speed reduced.

options.name: Trapfinding
options.benefit: Add half Slayer level to Perception checks to find traps and Disable Device checks.

options.name: Weapon Training
options.benefit: Gain Weapon Focus as a bonus feat.

options.name: Assassinate
options.benefit: Attempt to kill a studied target after studying it for 1 round.

options.name: Evasion
options.benefit: Take no damage on a successful Reflex save against qualifying effects.

options.name: Hunter's Surprise
options.benefit: Treat one creature as a studied target temporarily.

options.name: Improved Evasion
options.benefit: Retain half damage even on a failed qualifying Reflex save.

options.name: Master Tricks
options.benefit: Choose an eligible advanced rogue talent.

options.name: Opportunist
options.benefit: Make an attack of opportunity against a creature damaged in melee by an ally.
